content: Build the make.fun chess entry (BRIEFS.md CHESS section is binding): one self-contained main.py, hard limit 4,096 bytes, Python stdlib only, full rules (castling incl. through-check, en passant, promotions), UCI protocol, strongest compact engine possible (negamax + alpha-beta + iterative deepening, quiescence, MVV-LVA ordering), conservative clock handling for 10s + 0.1s/move. Validate with perft (startpos d3 8,902 / d4 197,281; Kiwipete 97,862; pos4 43,238; pos5 9,467), a UCI suite (mate-in-1, free-queen capture, clock go < 1s) and 20 clean self-play games. Add LICENSE, README, build transcript.

Built main.py (4,078 bytes): 0x88 board, full legal movegen, negamax + alpha-beta + iterative deepening, quiescence over captures/promotions, capture-first ordering, material + pawn-advancement eval, conservative time management. Perft 5/5 exact; UCI suite 11/11 PASS (mate-in-1, free-queen capture, clock go 0.50s, mated -> 0000); self-play 20 games zero illegal/crashes/timeouts; state integrity 8/8. Found and fixed a bug self-play exposed: a timeout abort left search moves applied and corrupted the board - fixed with unmake-on-abort plus a regression test.

Verification found a defect: FEN 6k1/5ppp/8/8/8/8/8/R5K1 w - - 0 1 is mate in 1 (a1a8); go depth 2/3 return a1a8, but go movetime 2000 and go wtime 3000 return a1b1 - the timed path answers before completing a shallow iteration. Fix: iteration 1 always completes; on abort return the last completed iteration's best move. Keep perft/UCI green and <= 4,096 bytes.

Fixed; final main.py 4,088 bytes. Root cause: (1) the root best move was overwritten live during each iteration, so a deadline abort returned the partial iteration's best-so-far (a1b1); (2) mate was invisible at depth 1 because quiescence leaves never checked for no legal moves, so a1a8 only became best at depth >= 2 - the iteration the abort could interrupt. Fix: hoisted the legal-move/mate-stalemate return above the quiescence filter; gated the deadline raise so iteration 1 always completes; the UCI loop snapshots the best move only after a completed iteration. Regression 6/6 PASS (a1a8 at wtime 3000 / movetime 2000 / movetime 500 / wtime 10000; free queen e1e8; midgame legal move 0.46s); perft 5/5; UCI suite all PASS; self-play 20 games clean. Orchestrator re-verified both originally failing cases.
